text_block_list.text:
That day was just one disaster after another.
I couldn't accept something and spoke my mind, only to touch a nerve
and blow things way out of proportion――

Overcome by self-reproach and exhaustion, I stopped at an izakaya,
only to drink too much and find myself unable to walk.
Feeling passersby giving me a wide berth as they walked past, I stood there at a total loss, when...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey there, tipsy one, are you alright?
Can you not stand up?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wait... are you a Trainer from the academy?
What's up?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
Looked like a pretty big deal to me, though.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Let's move for now. I'll go buy some water, so wait here!

As she nursed me back to my senses...
Between her comforting presence and the alcohol, before I knew it, I had confessed everything.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
—So that's why you were so tipsy.
What a crazy day!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You wanted to blow off steam better?
Hmm, well, you might have a point there.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Still, I get it. I'm the type to follow my heart too.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I want to be true to myself. But if I do,
I can't always be "righteous"... can I?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ――Oh, look at the time, I've gotta get going!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
What will you do? Call it a night?
Or shall I call a taxi for you?
choice_data_list: Rest some more until the drunkenness passes
Call a taxi and head straight home.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it.
I'm heading back, but... don't fall asleep here, okay?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, got it.
I'll look after them until the taxi arrives, then.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, hello.
I'd like to request a taxi, please—
